'''Dhur-Ell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Stationed on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], he asked for assistance in taking down an assassin who had murdered one of King [[Regalun Petryph]]'s cousins.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Catch the Assassin|Onderon}}</ref>
